a2-u2-l1#volny-cas.picture: A sunny Saturday afternoon on the grass by the Danube: Emma lies on her front reading a book with her shoes off, Lucia dozes in the sun beside her, and Tomáš throws a frisbee to Marek.

a2-u2-l1#kreslit-a-fotografovat.picture: Two halves on the square in the Old Town, by the fountain. Left: Emma sits on the fountain's edge, drawing the pastel houses in a sketchbook. Right: Lucia crouches to take a photo of the same houses with a camera.

a2-u2-l1#oddychovat-a-pozerat.picture: Evening at home: Tomáš lies stretched out on a sofa in his socks, a cushion behind his head and a bowl of crisps on his chest, watching TV.

a2-u2-l1#nakupne-centrum.picture: Inside a big, bright shopping centre with shops on two floors, escalators and a glass roof: Emma and Lucia sit at a small café table on the upper floor, shopping bags at their feet.

a2-u2-l1#stretavat-sa-s.picture: Saturday afternoon at the fountain on the square in the Old Town: Lucia, Tomáš and Marek are already waiting; Emma arrives and waves, and Lucia goes to hug her.

a2-u2-l2#rad-ta-pocujem.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Tomáš walks along the Danube embankment with his phone to his ear, beaming. Right: Lucia, at her desk in the dorm room, answers, delighted to hear from him.

a2-u2-l2#plavaren-a-sauna.picture: An indoor swimming pool with lanes under a high glass wall. Emma swims front crawl fast down one lane, with Tomáš far behind her in the next, impressed. Through a glass door at the side, Lucia sits in a wooden sauna, wrapped in a towel and red-cheeked.

a2-u2-l2#plavky.picture: In the dorm room, Emma packs her sports bag for the pool: she holds up her swimsuit, with a rolled towel and goggles beside the bag on her bed.

a2-u2-l2#plati.picture: In the café near the university, Tomáš holds out his hand across the table and Emma shakes it with a grin, while Lucia, beside her, gives a thumbs up: the plan is agreed.

a2-u2-l3#bohuzial-nemozem.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Lucia, at her desk in the dorm room, phone to her ear, asks hopefully. Right: Marek, in his white chef's jacket in the busy kitchen of his restaurant, holds the phone between ear and shoulder while stirring a big pot, and pulls an apologetic face.

a2-u2-l3#to-je-skoda.picture: In the dorm room, Lucia holds up a board game she has ready for Friday and sighs with disappointment, as Emma, pulling on her coat, shakes her head apologetically.

a2-u2-l3#upiect-tortu.picture: In the narrow kitchen of his flat, Marek, in his red flannel shirt and an apron, flour on his hands, lifts a round cake out of the oven and smiles at the smell.

a2-u2-l3#ja-to-nemusim.picture: In Marek's living room, Tomáš and Marek leap up from the sofa, cheering at a football match on the TV, while Lucia, curled up at the end of the sofa with a book, rolls her eyes.

a2-u2-l3#mam-alergiu-na.picture: In the hallway of a friend's flat, a fluffy grey cat rubs against Lucia's legs and she sneezes hard into a tissue, her eyes red and watery, while Emma scoops the cat away.

a2-u2-l5#hrat-volejbal.picture: On a sand volleyball court by the Danube, Tomáš leaps at the net to smash the ball, Marek beside him; on the other side, Emma and Lucia dive for it.

a2-u2-l5#cvicit-jogu.picture: In the dorm room, on mats between the beds, Lucia holds a calm yoga pose, balancing on one leg, while Emma tries to copy her and wobbles.

a2-u2-l5#lyzovat-sa.picture: On a sunny, snowy slope in the mountains, Tomáš skis down with ease, spraying snow; further up the slope, Emma stands on skis for the first time, arms out, wobbling.

a2-u2-l6#zimny-stadion.picture: The ice rink: a big indoor hall with a curved roof, white ice inside low boards and rows of seats around it. Skaters circle the ice; Lucia skates backwards, holding both of Emma's hands as Emma takes her first wobbly glides. By the boards, a counter hires out skates.

a2-u2-l6#spadnut.picture: On the ice rink, Emma's legs fly out from under her and she lands on the ice with a thump; Lucia skates up to her, trying not to laugh.

a2-u2-l6#modrina.picture: Back in the dorm room, Emma sits on her bed and rolls up her jeans to show Lucia a big blue-purple bruise on her knee; Lucia winces.

a2-u2-l8#vylet.picture: A day trip: Emma, Lucia, Tomáš and Marek, with backpacks, walk a path over a wooded hilltop, a castle ruin on the next hill ahead; Emma, in front, spreads her arms and breathes in the fresh air.

a2-u2-l8#plagat.picture: Emma and Lucia stop at a noticeboard at the university to look at a big colourful poster with a picture of a gorilla on it; smaller posters around it show a concert and a painting. The posters have pictures only, no writing.

a2-u2-l8#zoo.picture: Bratislava's zoo on a wooded hillside: Emma and Lucia stand among visitors at the big glass wall of the gorilla enclosure, where a big gorilla sits looking back at them; in the next enclosure monkeys swing on ropes, and a giraffe peers over the trees beyond.

a2-u2-l10#zbierat.picture: In the porter's lodge, pán Kováč proudly opens a thick album full of rows of colourful postage stamps for Emma; more albums are stacked high on the shelf behind him, and Emma stares, amazed.

a2-u2-l10#sach-a-karty.picture: Lucia's games evening in the dorm kitchen: at one end of the table, Tomáš plays chess with Emma, frowning in concentration; at the other end, Lucia deals out cards.

a2-u2-l10#spolocenska-hra.picture: Later at the games evening in the dorm kitchen, Emma, Lucia and Tomáš sit round a board game with a big board, lots of little pieces and cards; Tomáš frowns over a long rule booklet while Emma scratches her head.

a2-u2-l12#nechat.picture: Friday afternoon at the porter's lodge, the big clock on the wall at five: Marek, in his white chef's jacket under an open coat, sets a cake box down on the ledge of the lodge window and hurries off to work, waving; pán Kováč nods to him.

a2-u2-l12#prazdna-krabica.picture: In the porter's lodge, the big clock on the wall at seven: pán Kováč, back at his desk, lifts the lid of the cake box and stares into it. It is empty but for a few crumbs.

a2-u2-l12#svedok.picture: In the dormitory corridor, pán Kováč, playing detective with a magnifying glass and a notebook, questions Emma; she points down the corridor, remembering what she saw.

a2-u2-l14#vlasy.picture: Friday evening in the dormitory corridor: Emma, her skates over her shoulder, glimpses Filip hurrying round a corner, a young man with long straight brown hair falling over his face.

a2-u2-l14#brada.picture: Tomáš stands at a bathroom mirror and proudly trims his neat short black beard with small scissors.

a2-u2-l14#tichy-a-hanblivy.picture: In the dorm kitchen, Lucia chats away cheerfully to Filip, the new student; Filip looks at his feet, his hair over his face and his hands in his hoodie pocket, and says nothing.

a2-u2-l14#pes.picture: In Filip's dorm room, Filip's dog sits in a basket beside the bed, wagging its tail, a food bowl next to it; Filip kneels to stroke it.

a2-u2-l14#choice-prepacte-pan-kovac.picture: At the porter's lodge, Filip, red-faced, holds up his dog, its nose white with cream, and apologises to pán Kováč, who stands with his arms folded and a stern frown.
